tools.name: triage_inbox
tools.description: Rank RadMail's built-in sample inbox (six business emails) on two axes, importance and urgency. Returns each message's lane (Right Now, important but can wait, low) and any open promise on its thread, with overdue ones marked. Takes no input. Read-only.

tools.name: list_right_now
tools.description: Return only the Right Now lane of the sample inbox: messages that are both important and time-sensitive. Takes no input. Read-only.

tools.name: why_surfaced
tools.description: Explain why one sample-inbox message ranked where it did: the sender, urgency and promise signals behind its two scores. Pass a message_id (m_001 to m_006) from triage_inbox. Read-only.

message_id.description: An id from triage_inbox, e.g. m_001.

tools.name: list_commitments
tools.description: List the open promises you owe in the sample inbox (the full product also tracks promises owed to you), with who, by when, and whether each is overdue. Takes no input. Read-only.

tools.name: draft_reply
tools.description: Write a draft reply to one sample-inbox message for a person to review. Returns text only. It does not and cannot send. Pass a message_id from triage_inbox and optional guidance.

message_id.description: An id from triage_inbox to draft a reply for.

guidance.description: Optional steer for the draft. Never sent — review-only.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the sample inbox by sender, subject or body. Every word in the query must appear in a message. Returns matches most relevant and newest first, each saying where it matched. Read-only.

query.description: Words to find, matched against from / subject / body. Every word must appear somewhere in a message.
